title: Contract Debugging
concept: A systematic approach to debugging contract violations: reproduce, isolate, understand the counterexample, fix the root cause, and re-verify.
why: Contract violations are deterministic — unlike Heisenbugs, they reproduce every time. A methodical debugging process turns violations into quick fixes.
tips: The violation message IS your test case — copy the values directly into a reproducer
Use io.eprintln for debug output — it goes to stderr and won't interfere with function return values
Fix ONE contract violation at a time — fixing one may reveal another that was hidden
After fixing, run your FULL test suite — the fix might have changed behavior elsewhere
common_mistakes: Changing the contract to match the buggy behavior instead of fixing the bug
Adding debug output that changes the behavior (Heisenbug) — keep debug prints side-effect-free
Not re-running verification after the fix — assume it's fixed without proof
